mainEntity.name: Why does scope of information provided matter at the transparency stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because the first review works best when the objective, the current status, and the available facts are clear from the beginning. Before the next step, scope of information provided usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
